scripts.dev: npm run validate && concurrently -k -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm -w @crawler/client run dev" "npm -w @crawler/server run dev"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/content && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p scripts
scripts.build: npm run validate && npm -w @crawler/client run build
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run typecheck && npm test
